name: Tazzik's Dues
summary: Tazzik sent you to collect his winnings in Gadgetzan, but his arena champion earned nothing. You need to confront Tazzik about the unpaid debt.

sections.title: Back to the Port
sections.body: The collector points you back toward Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. Tazzik's champion lost quickly in the arena, so there are no winnings to collect. Tazzik may be trying to catch a ship out of port while you speak with the collector.

sections.title: Tazzik's Answer
sections.body: Tazzik admits he wagered everything he had on the fights to pay Friz, and lost it all. He says he cannot return her belongings and asks you to help him.

faq.answer: Tazzik's champion lost in the arena, and the collector says the fight earned no copper.

faq.q: Where does Tazzik want me to go?
faq.answer: The collector sends you back to Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris to confront Tazzik.

faq.q: Why should I hurry back to the port?
faq.answer: The collector thinks Tazzik may be trying to catch the next ship out of Steamwheedle Port.
Friz is the one Tazzik owes. He bet her money on a fight in the Gadgetzan arena, and his champion lost.
